title: Pure Igknight
summary: Igknight is a fiery Normal Pendulum archetype of militarized FIRE Warriors with uniform scale effects. Any two Igknights in the Pendulum Zones can destroy themselves to search any FIRE Warrior from the Deck or graveyard—loading the face-up Extra Deck while searching extenders like Ignis Phoenix and Immortal Phoenix Gearfried. The deck then Pendulum Summons in mass to access Beyond the Pendulum, Promethean Princess, and the untargeted removal of Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracoslayer.

allow.Immortal Phoenix Gearfried: Level 9 FIRE Warrior boss directly searchable by ANY Igknight Pendulum Zone effect that negates monster effects.
allow.Sublimation Knight: Level 3 FIRE Warrior starter directly searchable by ANY Igknight Pendulum Zone effect that equips Squeaknight from the Deck on Normal Summon.
allow.Squeaknight: FIRE Warrior that Special Summons itself when equipped to Sublimation Knight.
allow.Infernoble Knight - Renaud: Level 1 FIRE Warrior Tuner that Special Summons itself while you control a FIRE Warrior and tunes with a Level 4/6 Igknight into Level 8 Ignister Prominence.
allow.Summoner's Art: Searches Level 5 Igknight Cavalier or Level 6 Igknight Gallant / Igknight Margrave with zero cost.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Igknight Templar, Igknight Paladin, Igknight Crusader, or Sublimation Knight.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Ignition Phoenix.
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches any missing Pendulum Scale and destroys 2 cards on the field after you Pendulum Summon.
allow.Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames: Link-3 FIRE monster that revives a FIRE Igknight or Ignis Phoenix from the GY and pops a FIRE Igknight you control + an opponent's Special Summoned monster from the GY.
allow.Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracos: Level 8 FIRE Dragon Synchro that pops a Pendulum Card to shuffle 1 card on the opponent's field into the Deck without targeting.
allow.Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracosla: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Igknights and Ignis Phoenix that searches any Pendulum Monster during the End Phase.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior upon destruction.
allow.S:P Little Knight: Link-2 Warrior providing temporary banish disruption.
allow.Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon: Level 8 Synchro boss that negates monster effects and overwhelms high-Level threats in battle.
allow.Red-Eyes Flare Metal Dragon: Rank 7 Dragon boss that burns the opponent for 500 damage on every single card activation.
